whoWeAre.title: A National Institution Dedicated to Digital Excellence
whoWeAre.description: INPTIC is a higher education and professional training institution specializing in Information Technology, Telecommunications, Networks, Digital Systems, Management, and Innovation. Our mission is to develop highly skilled engineers, technology professionals, and future leaders capable of supporting Algeria's digital transformation through education, research, and industry collaboration.

items.question: How do I apply for the 2026 Engineering program?
items.answer: You can apply online through our official admissions portal. The process requires a completed application form, official transcripts, and passing our entrance examination.

items.question: Are there scholarships available for international students?
items.answer: Yes! INPTIC offers merit-based scholarships and financial aid programs for both local and international students who demonstrate exceptional academic records.

items.question: Is the E-Learning platform available 24/7?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our digital campus and all recorded lectures, resources, and interactive quizzes are accessible 24/7 from anywhere in the world.

items.question: What industry partnerships does INPTIC have?
items.answer: We partner with leading global telecom operators, tech giants, and local startups to provide our students with hands-on internships, direct mentorship, and job placements.

items.question: Can professionals enroll in master's programs part-time?
items.answer: Yes, our professional training and specialized master's programs offer flexible evening and weekend schedules designed specifically for working professionals.
